name: Hail of Splinters
text:
A fusillade of jagged splinters flies from you. Creatures in a 30-foot cone take floor((@actor.level -1/2)+1)d4 piercing,floor((@actor.level -1/2)+1)d4 persistent,bleed damage with a basic Reflex save save against your class DC.

---

Level (+2) Each type of damage increases by 1d4.
